payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (commit 9fcfa68). Native FR-256 client half redone ADDITIVELY: the existing Swift/Kotlin subscribe/subscribeObject/subscribeProjection are UNCHANGED (no test breakage). New opt-in variants subscribeObjectRegistered / subscribeStreamRegistered / subscribeProjectionRegistered send the Subscribe then resolve on the server post-registration reply (Snapshot/StreamPage by subscriptionId; ProjectionDelta by name), draining all waiters on close/disconnect. Swift gained a StreamPage dispatch case. VERIFIED by running the FULL suites this time (the lesson from the revert): Swift 177 tests 0 failures (3 new); Android :frick full testDebugUnitTest green (2 new, bounded withTimeout so a regression fails fast, never hangs). The 2h SwiftPM deadlock is impossible now — existing methods never block.
